Ganesh Visarjan 2026 Dates and Timings Announced

Ganesh Visarjan in 2026 is scheduled for September 25, marking the conclusion of the Ganesh Utsav. Auspicious timings for the farewell ceremony have been announced. In Delhi, these include periods from 6:10 AM to 10:42 AM, 12:12 PM to 1:43 PM, 4:44 PM to 6:14 PM, and 9:13 PM to 10:43 PM. Preparations for the procession of Lalbaugcha Raja in Mumbai are in their final stages.
